blind_spots_patched: Original ch-6 missed three critical balance-sheet footnotes: (1) a 10x unit scaling error on receivables, equity, and borrowings; (2) the first-time Ind AS restatement cutting FY25 PBT by ₹13.67 Cr (₹65.21 Cr to ₹51.54 Cr) and equity by ₹15.51 Cr (₹195.51 Cr to ₹180.00 Cr); and (3) the split between restricted QIP monitoring cash (₹87.16 Cr) and thin unrestricted operating cash (₹5.15 Cr) at Sep 30, 2026 alongside ₹45.27 Cr newly deployed into two subsidiaries/loans.

Original ch-1 and ch-5 did not capture co-founder Wg. Cdr. Jaganmohan Manthena's Nov 12, 2026 resignation from the Board, Audit Committee, and Nomination & Remuneration Committee, his deferred 10.43 lakh share (3.61%) off-market transfer at ₹800/share, promoter-group open-market disposals by Thiagaraja Annamalai, or ongoing warrant dilution through June 17, 2027.

Original ch-4 framed IndiGo solely as a passenger belly-cargo competitor, overlooking that IndiGo CarGo already operates three dedicated Airbus A321P2F converted freighters (27-tonne payload—23% larger than Afcom's 22-tonne B737-800BCF) on scheduled international routes.
assumptions_changed: BROKEN: Baseline ch-3 and ch-6 reported FY26 trade receivables as ₹13.62 Cr (FY25: ₹5.95 Cr), FY26 shareholders' equity as ₹45.67 Cr, and FY26 borrowings (ex-leases) as ₹40.07 Cr, while omitting H1 FY27 CFO and balance-sheet lines.
WEAKENED: Baseline ch-6 claimed the 733 bps drop in promoter shareholding (42.73% to 35.40%) came almost solely from new share issuance (QIP/preferential dilution) rather than promoter selling.
WEAKENED: Baseline ch-5 noted the 4th and 5th B737-800BCF narrowbodies were pending post-QIP deployment and stated Afcom had not published investor calls.
WEAKENED: Baseline ch-3 assumed weak FY26 CFO-to-PAT conversion (29.5%) persisted due to expanding 85-day receivables without H1 FY27 working-capital verification.
WEAKENED: Baseline ch-1 presented the founding leadership team (Capt. Deepak Parasuraman and co-founder Wg. Cdr. Jaganmohan Manthena) as intact post-QIP.
